save_user_profile.description: Submit final user profile data after all fields are collected and user confirmed.

displayName.description: User's full name or preferred handle. Must be a realistic human name or professional alias. Reject offensive terms or profanity.

companyName.description: Official company, organization, or business entity name. Reject placeholder names or generic email provider domains (e.g., 'gmail').

profession.description: User's professional title, role, or occupation (e.g., 'Software Engineer', 'Product Manager'). Reject joke answers, inanimate objects, or nonsensical responses.

email.description: Primary contact email address. Must be a valid, properly formatted email address (e.g., name@company.com). Read-only if already present from the user session/profile.

companyUrl.description: Optional official company website or URL (e.g., 'https://company.com' or 'company.com').

required.label: Email Address
required.validation_rule: Must be a valid, properly formatted email address. If an email is already present from authentication or session, it is read-only and must not be changed.

required.label: Display Name
required.validation_rule: Must be a realistic name or handle. Reject profanity.

required.label: Company Name
required.validation_rule: Must be a legitimate business or organization name. Reject generic email provider names (e.g., 'gmail').

required.label: Profession
required.validation_rule: Must be a realistic, recognizable human job title or career. Reject joke answers, objects, or nonsensical responses (e.g., 'moon', 'ninja', 'potato').

required.label: Company Website
required.validation_rule: Optional. If provided, must be a valid company website address or domain (e.g., https://company.com or company.com).
